        rr = (o["r0"] + o["r1"]) / 2
        cx = (o["c0"] + o["c1"]) / 2
        if (rr - cr) * vd >= 0 or (cx - cc) * hd >= 0:
            continue

        # Favor objects oriented like the guide's longer leg and nearest
        # to the elbow among eligible objects.
        bh = o["r1"] - o["r0"] + 1
        bw = o["c1"] - o["c0"] + 1
        vertical_match = (vlen >= hlen and bh >= bw) or (hlen > vlen and bw >= bh)
        distance = abs(rr - cr) + abs(cx - cc)
        candidates.append((int(vertical_match), -distance, len(o["cells"]), o))

    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    target = max(candidates, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2]))[3]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in target["cells"]:
        out[r][c] = guide["color"]
    return out
